name: Tapo P110 (UK)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (802.11b/g/n). TP-Link's US datasheet mentions Bluetooth for setup, but we didn't confirm that for the UK model.

matter.note: The UK P110 pages don't mention Matter or rule it out. TP-Link's Matter version is the separate Tapo P110M.

apple_home.note: TP-Link lists Alexa, Google Assistant and SmartThings for the P110 and doesn't mention Apple Home, but no page says it's unsupported. The P110M is the Matter version.

google_home.note: Link your TP-Link account in Google Home after setting the plug up in the Tapo app. The step-by-step guide is TP-Link's general FAQ on its US site; the UK pages list Google Assistant.

alexa.note: Through the Tapo Alexa skill, linked from the Tapo app or the Alexa app. The how-to is TP-Link's general FAQ on its US site; the UK pages list Alexa.

smartthings.note: Link your TP-Link ID in the SmartThings app. TP-Link's SmartThings FAQ (general, on its US site) lists the P110; the UK page shows SmartThings. TP-Link FAQs disagree on whether energy data reaches SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's TP-Link Smart Home integration lists the P110 among supported Tapo plugs. Set it up in the Tapo app first.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi plug that joins your router directly and is set up in the Tapo app.

localControl.note: TP-Link's Tapo plug FAQ (P100/P105/P110/P115) says the Tapo app can control the plug locally without internet; Smart Actions then need a Tapo hub.

energyMonitoring.note: Live and historical energy use in the Tapo app.

maxLoadWatts.note: TP-Link's UK spec sheet: 2990 W, 13 A, 1/6 HP motor, 220-240 V. Tapo's UK page says EV charging isn't supported.

summary: Linked through your TP-Link account, the UK Tapo P110 works with Alexa, Google Home and SmartThings, and Home Assistant's official TP-Link integration supports it as well. It's a 13 A, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi plug rated 2990 W, no hub needed, with live and historical energy use in the Tapo app. The app can also control it locally without internet. TP-Link doesn't list Apple Home; its Matter version is the P110M.
caveats: Apple Home and Matter aren't listed; the Tapo P110M is the Matter version.
TP-Link's own FAQs disagree on whether energy data reaches SmartThings, so expect to check usage in the Tapo app.
Tapo says it isn't for EV charging.
